🇲🇽📊 SHEINBAUM FIRES BACK AT MOODY'S WITH 12 HARD FACTS — RECORD FDI, 2.5% UNEMPLOYMENT, PEMEX DEBT DOWN $20B

Sheinbaum responded to Moody's downgrade with 12 economic indicators: record FDI in Q1 2026 — the highest in Mexico's history. Unemployment at 2.5%, top 3 globally. Peso stable at 17.40. Gasoline prices among the world's lowest despite the Iran war driving global energy costs up.

Pemex cut its debt by $20 billion. The fiscal deficit dropped 1.5% of GDP. Tax collection rose from 14.7% to 15.2% of GDP. April registered the highest formal employment ever recorded.

"Twelve good news items, twelve arguments for why we're doing well, in the middle of a difficult international situation," she said. Carlos Slim agreed, calling Moody's rating "irrational."

🇲🇽🌎 US SUPREME COURT LIMITS RÍO BRAVO PUMPING — WATER FLOW TO MEXICO AT STAKE

The US Supreme Court approved a historic agreement limiting underground water extraction from the Río Bravo basin, ending New Mexico's unchecked pumping that reduced flow along the Mexico-US border.

The ruling strips irrigation rights from southern New Mexico farming zones and mandates long-term fallowing programs. "We are very enthusiastic about redirecting resources from costly litigation," said Interstate Waterway Commission director Hanna Riseley-White.

The Río Bravo sustains millions across Chihuahua, Coahuila, Nuevo León, and Tamaulipas. Scientists warn drought and overexploitation threaten the entire basin — any upstream regulation that protects flow is a direct win for Mexico's water security.

🇲🇽🌎 TMEC ROUND TWO SET FOR JUNE 16-17 IN WASHINGTON — EBRARD DEMANDS TARIFF REMOVAL

The USTR confirmed the second round of TMEC formal negotiations for June 16-17 in Washington DC, with a third round set for July 20 in Mexico City. The first round wrapped today covering automotive, minerals, agriculture, and economic security.

Ebrard's position: Mexico will demand the removal of tariffs on steel, aluminum, and auto parts — levies that contradict the free-trade agreement they claim to be reviewing. Mexico will "emphasize both nations' economic integration," he said.

The review sets the terms for North American trade through 2036. Three rounds, three months — the clock is running.

🇲🇽🔥 32 CARTEL KINGPINS DOWN — MEXICO DISMANTLES CJNG AND SINALOA STRUCTURES FROM THE INSIDE

Mexico's Security Cabinet confirmed 32 priority criminal targets detained, including 18 key CJNG operators and 14 Sinaloa Cartel leaders. Among them: Don Rodo — Mencho's brother and CJNG's top financial operator — and Chavo Félix, Mayo Zambada's son-in-law.

The numbers since Sheinbaum took office: 42,766 criminals apprehended, 22,413 weapons seized, 192 tons of drugs confiscated. In Sinaloa alone — 2,500+ arrested, 5,500 firearms, 1 million+ cartridges, 68,000 kg of drugs, 2,000+ clandestine labs dismantled, and 1,200 bank accounts frozen.

Harfuch: homicides down 50% in Jalisco from sustained operations. No foreign boots on the ground required.

🚨🇲🇽 10 SUICIDES IN ICE DETENTION UNDER TRUMP — ONE WAS A 19-YEAR-OLD MEXICAN STOPPED ON A SCOOTER

An AP investigation found 10 detainees have killed themselves in ICE custody since Trump took office — the highest rate in the agency's history. Seven since October alone, when the historical average was one or zero per year.

All 10 were men, average age 32. Nine were Hispanic. Among them, a 19-year-old Mexican detained for a minor traffic violation while riding his scooter. Staff ignored warning signs, delayed mental health care, and allowed at-risk detainees access to materials used for self-harm.

These 10 suicides account for nearly one-fifth of the 51 total deaths in ICE custody since January 2025. This is what mass detention without due process looks like.
